title: Chapter 106
text:
Alphonse gave the phone to Han Xiao. "This is my number. Call me if you need anything."

Han Xiao knocked on the table and said, "I have some questions. I want to increase my authority in the Blood Pact Society as soon as possible. Do you have any suggestions?"

Alphonse thought for a while and decided to return the favor to Han Xiao. He asked the waiter to bring over the Blood Pact Society's computer and showed a file to Han Xiao. At the top of the file, there was a clear sign that said, 'Do not read without permission.'

Han Xiao raised his eyebrows and looked down.

Internal Enlistment Order (Not Public)

Recruitment Target: Blood Pact Society Assassins (Dark Grade and above), Contract Mercenaries (Two Star and above)

Current Number of Participants: 18 Assassins, 245 Mercenaries

Mission Location: River Valley Manor, East of Stardragon, outside Seagull City, twenty miles north.

Mission Details: Guard River Valley Manor and protect (Data Hidden)

"Internal Recruitment Order?"

"Only Dark Grade assassins and above will be recruited. You are now a Scorpion-grade assassin, so it is against the rules to participate in this mission. However, I can help you behind the scenes. Once the mission is completed, you will be promoted to Dark Grade. When you arrive at the location, someone will inform you of the details of the mission. "

Han Xiao thought to himself. With so many people participating, it would probably be a small scale battle.

He remembered that he could trigger another mission in Seagull City that was easy but had high rewards. He could go there on the way.

"Let's go take a look first."

Han Xiao made up his mind.

I didn't expect to return to Stardragon so soon. Luckily, I won't be recognized.

Han Xiao raised his eyebrows. When he left Division 13, the faction relationship on the interface did not change. This meant that Division 13 did not see him as an enemy.

There was still some time before his departure, so he returned to the Fabian Organization base and built the machine that he had always wanted to build.

Second Generation Ranger (Combat Type)

Type: Robot

Quality: Dark Green

Basic Attributes: 2,200 Armor, 37 Defense, 168 Power Level, 83km/h Maximum Movement Speed, 640/640 Energy

Height: 2.1 Meters

Weight: 830 pounds

Control Method: Low-level Smart Chip (Program Setting, Enemy Detection)

Energy Source: High Energy Battery Pack x4

Combat Consumption: 6 energy/min (Low intensity), 15 energy/min (Full power)

Core Power: 310/320

Brain Module: Intelligent Fire Control System. Power Usage: 30

Eye Module: Electromagnetic Scanning Lens. Allows you to see through obstacles. Power Usage: 1/5

Right Arm Module: Large Caliber Triple Barreled Machine Gun. Attack 70 ~ 85. Fire Rate 3.5/s. Capacity 30 + 90 (Bullet Chain). Output Level 75. Power Usage 40.

Left Arm Module: Large Caliber Triple Barreled Machine Gun as above

Skeleton Module: K600 Power Endoskeleton. Provides 30 STR. Power Usage: 40

Leg Module: Triangular Track Wheels + Shockproof Air Suspension. Reduces impact from harsh terrain and increases movement speed. Power Usage: 1/5

Chest Module: Mini Honeycomb Rocket Launcher. Equipped with mini rockets (Attack 180-230, Explosive Damage). Capacity: 6 rounds. Power Usage: 110

Abdomen Module: Magazine, Mini Rocket Launcher x12, Additional Ammo Chain 200, Power Usage 20

Additional Ability: Volley Burst — Launch a volley of attacks at the enemy. + 7% damage

Additional Ability: Platinum Alloy — Increases armor value and reduces physical damage by 11%

Additional Ability: Self Destruct — Deals 340-510 fire damage within a 40-meter radius. Destroys after use.

Remarks: Human Tank.

The Rangers that were built this time were much more technologically advanced. They were equipped with smart chips, platinum alloy armor, high energy batteries, and even more powerful firepower. Now that Han Xiao was much wealthier than when he first entered the Western Capital, he did not need to count with his fingers anymore. The cost of a single second-generation Ranger was more than 200,000, and this was even after he had saved a lot of parts due to his technological advancements. At his level, it was impossible for a player like him to play with it. The second-generation Ranger could be used as a mobile fortress, but because the processing chip was not enough to perform three-dimensional tactical thinking and battlefield analysis, it did not have any unique abilities.

The powerful combat Rangers could provide firepower support and AOE attacks. Even if they ran out of ammo, the K600 Power Endoskeleton gave the second generation Rangers close combat strength. At the very least, they could be used to ram people at full speed. They also had the ability to self-destruct.

Now, I can build the Rangers on a large scale, but I can't carry them around. I should find a secret base. Although this type of turret-like robot has powerful firepower, it is not suitable for fast and agile battlefield changes. It can only be used for positional warfare. The main problems are its mobility, core power, and chip processing. I need advanced knowledge, but I don't have the chance yet … Hmm, I can only maintain the sniper combat mode and continue to improve the sniper.

The idea of a robot army could not be formed yet. There were gaps in funding and technology.

Han Xiao's large equipment was stored in the Fabian Group's warehouse and transported by plane. This time, he spent 50,000 RMB to use the Fabian Group's transport service. No one would be as spendthrift as him.

…

The Western Capital was the capital of Stardragon, and Seagull City was an important city in the east of Stardragon. It was huge and had been attacked by a Beast Tide in history. It suffered heavy losses, but it received help from the entire country and became an important city in the east.

A monument that was dozens of meters tall stood in the center of the city. It was engraved with the names of all the victims who resisted the Beast Tide.

During the Old Era war, Seagull City was attacked by the Germinal Organization on a large scale. Once again, it received help from everywhere and became even more prosperous. This phenomenon was very strange. It was full of disasters, but it developed quickly. The people of Stardragon thought that this was a good sign. It meant that even if Stardragon suffered setbacks, it would become stronger and stronger. The 'Spirit of Seagull' appeared many times in the annual leadership meetings and news broadcasts.

The plane landed in Seagull City's airport. Every city had to pass through the checkpoints to enter and leave the city, but they had to obtain permission from the airport control station to land in the air. The Fabian Group's plane had the permission to land in the airports of every city in Stardragon. It was considered a private plane. As long as the players had a high enough affinity with the faction, they could also buy it.

"Speaking of which, why are you here again?" Han Xiao turned to look at Antonio.

Antonio took a puff of the cigar in his hand and laughed. "Unfortunately, the Fabian Group does not have any assets in Seagull City. We can't provide you with any services. We can only lend you the transport plane as a temporary workshop and warehouse."

"Oh, I see." Han Xiao understood. Suddenly, he realized that he did not have a car to lend. He suddenly felt a headache. He was still a few dozen miles away from the mission location, River Valley Manor. Did he have to resort to the unethical and unethical act of stealing cars again?

He did have a Thorns, but the problem was that if he were to drive this car on the streets, he would probably be followed by dozens of police cars and a few explosion-proof special police vehicles in less than ten minutes.

As the old saying went, if there was a problem, look for the masses.

Han Xiao borrowed a car from a kind-hearted and generous person. He passed through the checkpoint, left the city, and went straight to River Valley Manor.

Twenty miles north of Seagull City was a small forest with a small river flowing through it. This small forest was inhabited by gentle and small beasts, so it was not very dangerous. The River Valley Manor was located in a shallow river valley in the forest. It was built by the river. This was what Han Xiao saw on the map.

When he drove into the forest, it was already afternoon. The lazy sunlight shone through the gaps in the forest, creating a peaceful and natural atmosphere. The sound of the engine startled a few spotted deer that were sleeping.

He suddenly wrinkled his nose and smelled a faint pungent smell. After quickly filtering out the humus and bird feces in his mind, he found a memory of a similar smell. His eyes flashed. "This is the smell of guns that haven't dispersed yet. A battle broke out here not long ago."

To prevent any misunderstandings, Han Xiao stopped the car, took his equipment, and walked.

His current appearance was that of a middle-aged man in a black windbreaker who was carrying a guitar case. He looked like a depressed wandering musician. In fact, he stored the folded Red Falcon sniper rifle and the lightweight mechanical arm. The Berserk Eagle and magazine were hidden under his clothes, and the magnetically controlled retractable armor was hidden close to his body. There was a retractable knife hanging on his waist, and the gloves on his hands were the inactive thermal cutting gloves. He wore silver-gray electromagnetic skateboard boots that were the same size as normal boots. The leather was sewn on the outside, and one would not be able to see the metal material in the boots without pressing them personally. As for Windcutter, Thorns, and Second Generation Ranger, he did not bring them with him.

After walking for a while, he saw clear signs of battle around him. There were burn marks from explosions, scattered bullet casings, ruts, and even burnt car shells. There was more than one. It was clear that the battle was fierce. He could already see the shallow river outside the forest, and River Valley Manor came into view.

Han Xiao was about to walk over when he suddenly stopped.

The next moment, there was a bullet hole in the ground in front of him. If he had walked forward just now, he would have been hit in the calf.

The shot was clearly a warning.
